# crosswork_data_gateway_destinations (Resource)

This resource can manage a data destination of the Crosswork Data Gateways.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_data_gateway_destinations" "example" {
  name               = "cwtest-gen-destination"
  data_source        = "data-gateway"
  server_type        = "kafka"
  encoding           = "gpbkv"
  compression_method = "snappy"
  max_message_size   = 100000000
  buffer_memory      = 52428800
  batch_size         = 1048576
  linger_time        = 2000
  request_timeout    = 30
  collectors = [
    {
      name            = "CLI"
      buffer_memory   = 104857600
      batch_size      = 500000
      linger_time     = 1000
      request_timeout = 45
    }
  ]
  connections = [
    {
      address       = "10.14.0.150"
      prefix_length = 20
      port          = 9192
    }
  ]
  secure = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `compression_method` (String) Compression of the data, `snappy`, `gzip`, `zstd` or `none` for Kafka and `gzip`, `deflate` or `snappy` for gRPC
  - Choices: `snappy`, `gzip`, `zstd`, `none`, `deflate`
- `connections` (Attributes List) Addresses of the destination server, each an IPv4 address with a prefix length or a host name with a domain name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections))
- `data_source` (String) Source of the data sent to the destination
  - Choices: `data-gateway`, `application`
- `name` (String) Destination name, made of letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and dots
- `server_type` (String) Type of the destination server
  - Choices: `kafka`, `grpc`

### Optional

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication of the secure communication; a gRPC destination takes only `mutual`
  - Choices: `mutual`, `server`
- `batch_size` (Number) Batch size of a Kafka destination in bytes, at most the buffer memory
  - Range: `16384`-`52428800`
- `buffer_memory` (Number) Buffer memory of a Kafka destination in bytes
  - Range: `52428800`-`314572800`
- `collectors` (Attributes List) Values of a Kafka destination that replace the global ones for one collector (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collectors))
- `dispatch_type` (String) Dispatch type of a gRPC destination
  - Choices: `stream`, `unary`
- `encoding` (String) Encoding of the data, for the data source `data-gateway`
  - Choices: `gpbkv`, `json`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `linger_time` (Number) Linger time of a Kafka destination in milliseconds
  - Range: `0`-`5000`
- `max_message_size` (Number) Maximum message size of a Kafka destination in bytes
  - Range: `1000000`-`100000000`
- `request_timeout` (Number) Request timeout of a Kafka destination in seconds
  - Range: `30`-`60`
- `secure` (Boolean) Enable secure communication

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `system_defined` (Boolean) Whether Crosswork defined the destination, which makes it read-only

Required:

  - Range: `1024`-`65535`

- `host_name` (String) Host name
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the IPv4 address
  - Range: `1`-`32`

Required:

  - Choices: `CLI`, `GNMI`, `MDT`, `SNMP`, `SYSLOG`

  - Range: `16384`-`52428800`
- `buffer_memory` (Number) Buffer memory in bytes
  - Range: `52428800`-`314572800`
- `linger_time` (Number) Linger time in milliseconds
  - Range: `0`-`5000`
- `request_timeout` (Number) Request timeout in seconds
  - Range: `30`-`60`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_data_gateway_destinations.example "<id>"
```
